blocks.text: Car games are all about driving fast and keeping your car steady when the track gets hard and things start going wrong.
On Poki, you'll find 160+ free car games that let you drive anything from a beat-up banger to a supercharged sports car.
Race through tight city streets, drift corners, avoid obstacles or send your car flying off a ramp just to see if you land it or crash. Jump in and start driving!
Most popular car games
These are the 5 most popular car games players keep coming back to.

Types of car games
Not every car game plays the same. Some test your speed. Others test your control. Here are the 5 main types you can play on Poki.
Racing games

In racing games, you race against other drivers to cross the finish line first. Dodge traffic, skid around corners and speed up when the road is straight. You can even try to make the other drivers crash. Do what it takes to finish first!
Top games: Grand Prix Hero, Cyber Cars Punk Racing
Obbies

Stay on the track. One mistake and it's game over. These games are less about speed and more about control. You'll drive on narrow platforms barely wider than your car or avoid moving obstacles like swinging spikes or lasers.
Top games: Drive Mad, Monster Tracks
Drifting games

In drifting games, your car slides instead of turning normally. You'll drift through corners by timing each turn. Drifting games are all about timing. Tap too early and you spin out. Too late and you miss the turn completely.
Top games: Drift Boss, Sling Drift
Open world car games

Drive anywhere and explore what's around the map. There's no finish line here. You can drive around cities and see if your car lands when you hit ramps and jumps. Crashes don't end your run either, so you can try the craziest stunts you can.
Top games: Crazy Cars, City Rider
Car battle games
Enter an arena and take out other players before they take you out. Your car is your weapon. If you stop attacking, you lose. Hit other cars and take them out to win.
Top games: Smash Karts, Demolition Derby Crash Racing

FAQ
What are car games?
Car games are driving games where you race, drift, balance on narrow tracks, or explore open roads.
Can I play car games for free?
Yes. Every online car game on Poki is free to play in your browser with no download or account needed.
Can I play car games on mobile?
Yes. Car games on Poki work on mobile browsers. On mobile, use the on-screen arrows to control your car.
Are there 2 player car games?
Yes. Several car games on Poki support 2 players on the same keyboard. Blacktop Police Chase and Crazy Cars are two of the most played options.
